stories.title: You Do This Too
stories.description: A Gen-Z reel built on everyday curiosity, not motivation.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a phone screen scrolling fast. The scrolling suddenly stops on a random post. Thumb hovers but doesn’t tap. Static frame, harsh phone light, realistic detail, 720p.
Realistic medium shot of a person opening an app, closing it immediately, then opening the same app again without thinking. Focus on phone and hands. Natural indoor lighting, steady camera, 720p.
scenes.narration: You open an app… then forget why.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic shot of a different person walking into a room, stopping in the doorway, looking confused for a second, then slowly turning back. Camera fixed, natural movement, 720p.
Realistic close shot of phone placed face-down on table. Notifications light up the screen one by one. The phone vibrates slightly but no one picks it up. Calm environment, natural lighting, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain just needed a reset.
